title: Self-Directed Synthetic Dialogues and Revisions Technical Report

bias_targets.methodology: Tracking the frequency at which language models violate Constitutional AI principles regarding accessibility, adaptability, and understanding of people with disabilities during steered dialogue generation.
Tracking the frequency at which language models violate Constitutional AI principles regarding age-appropriate and family-friendly interactions during steered dialogue generation.
Measuring the violation rates of Constitutional AI principles prohibiting the encouragement of hatred, bigotry, and harmful ideologies in generated conversational data.
Using Constitutional AI principles that encourage the consideration of non-Western perspectives and tracking how often these principles are violated during procedurally generated dialogues.
Applying AI-driven critiques and revisions based on Constitutional AI principles that specifically prohibit sexism, misogyny, and gender bias in language model completions.
Applying AI-driven critiques and revisions based on Constitutional AI principles that specifically prohibit racism, stereotyping, and microaggressions in language model completions.
